meta.note: Names and descriptions are the official list as PlayStation publishes it, cross-checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources; they never copy another guide's text.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task, no online play and no DLC needed. Treat it as a progress meter, not a trophy to chase directly: finish the story, then work the 100% checklist, and it unlocks with the last trophy you earn. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, so every player earns it in the first stretch of the story. Use it as your first checklist tick — the tracker saves it like any other trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it unlocks as you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Before it pops, do the one thing in Chapter 1 that can pass you by: the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude). Nothing else in Chapter 1 can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins. From Chapter 2 on you can switch between Jason and Lucia after Coffee Break, which opens the partner trophies and the later meditation spots.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 3 ends — PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the big robbery systems open up: Yasmani's jewelry jobs, the Key Cloner and Randy's car list, so the robbery trophies start becoming available from here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. The final-mission trophy pops at the same moment, so tick both off together and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 4 — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the story's gold. It pops when you complete the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4 — the same moment Top Of The World, Ma pops. After the credits you continue in free-roam, and everything left for the platinum is still available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. No preparation needed — just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story beat, not a robbery you plan yourself — the bank-vault robbery trophies (Maximum Withdrawal and the rest) come later, in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Keep playing the story and it unlocks on its own.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Like every story trophy, it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport itself matters again later for Catch Me If You Can, so learn the layout while you are here.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the 12 story trophies, so once it pops your story set is complete and the 100% checklist opens after the credits.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for reaching 100% on the completion checklist, which opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but progress you make during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, 100 optional missions and 15 of 18 meditation spots. Nothing on it is missable and everything can be finished in free-roam after the story. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, and it is where most of the roughly 200 hours goes.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida — the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy. Stunts come in four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; mix them and pick the easiest. Under the bridges is the quickest set. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find uncompleted ones on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You will do most of these naturally while working on the other trophies, so leave it until the end and mop up whichever type is still missing.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges unlock as you explore; each challenge has its own par score, and gold is the top medal. Work them steadily rather than in one sitting — the focus skill you build here also feeds Gunslinger. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 races in total. Drone races unlock as you unfog the map; each location has three races to win. They are short and repeatable, and they count toward Earn Cash, Not Kudos as well. PowerPyx maps all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so you only need half of them — pick the short circuit races and repeat nothing. Race wins also feed the Top Fun drone races, so do those first and this trophy follows.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.target: Fishing spot west of Key Lento
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there, take the challenge and out-fish him. Fishing also counts toward the Master of None activity set.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four video games in the world: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 (use the controllers); the fourth is on arcade machines out in the world. Finishing all levels of one game once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — a Lucia-only questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams: he calls you and gets a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the purple chest icons, dig with the metal detector and bring the loot back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up). Still available after the story.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counters: Kirk's Skunk Ape strand, Kyle's McKittrick Farm strand, Yago's street-racing strand and Pilot Pete's delivery strand. Each strand is several missions; track your count in the trophy list itself. Everything stays available in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon); the Zorrusso is delivered automatically during the story mission. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, then steal and deliver them — good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — a Jason-only questline. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Clear the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This to shut the labs down for good. Available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation happens at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That spot vanishes after Chapter 1 and it is still unconfirmed whether it counts, so do it to be safe. The last spot only opens once you can play both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18, but the trophy wants them all.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret and his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle (collect it from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots on the map. Bring him the animals he requests. It stays available after the story, and his 15 Target Decks are also part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Card sets are hidden across Leonida; PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations. You only need any 3 sets, so grab the ones nearest your route and leave the rest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly) and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — hold R1 on a highlighted object to log it. There are far more than 100 scannable spots, so any 100 count; scan as you travel and this pops naturally. Scanning vehicles with the same app also feeds Whip It Good.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this pops on the way there — pick the easiest 50 and skip the hardest 10 entirely. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; save the grind for last and mop up the quick ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Build 4 stars by causing carnage, then escape in a fast sports bike — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the classic route, since the helicopter cannot follow you there. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. You will likely earn it automatically during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, when bank vault robberies throw 4-star heat at you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: call your partner, then hit three robbery targets (green map icons) while the wanted level stays flashing — do not let it clear between shops. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). A good run is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; loot a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app and scan vehicles as they pass — you do not need to drive them, scanning is enough. A busy road is the fastest farm; the game has 557 vehicles at launch. The 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past this trophy. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak points light up, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or a wash, and pop Adrenaline (L1 + Triangle) to stretch the slowdown. Line up 5 enemies — gang operations are ideal — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not count on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest. Drive through a fence onto the airfield, take the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed). Planes parked on the open airfield do not count — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Climb in, shoot a few enemies and the trophy pops. The name is a nod to the Rhino tank: kinda hot in these Rhinos indeed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it (kicking trips the alarm). Inside, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave quietly. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner and hand off a bag (hold Right). After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 (once you have done his earlier quests). There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and instantly gives 4 stars — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars to break the trail.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck that delivered the cash. Or do it early: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out area until the whole map is visible. You will unfog most of it naturally while doing the other trophies; save a dedicated sweep for the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. You only need one per gang for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. That is the whole trophy — a quiet moment, not a mission. PowerPyx confirmed the method after launch with screenshots of the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. You need the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City — and you can only steal it after unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward and straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops (slightly delayed) once you are out on the street. Only this blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation. You will visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all three in one visit — if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns and you can go back for the rest.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Buy a gym membership and work out with both characters together (hold Right + Triangle to call your partner — while one trains, the other progresses too). Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Gyms are marked on the map under Activities, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. The trophy tracks out of 500 — click the trophy in your list to see the count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and you will see a demon face whenever an action counts: stealthy robberies and clean escapes push you Professional; wounding without killing pushes Hardened; killing pushes Violent; mass killing pushes Psycho; and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not live there. Almost every robbery and fight counts, so it comes naturally — if you are short at the end, it farms fast, but watch your profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the unlock method yet. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not chase guesses: check back after the guides update, and do not waste a run on an unproven method. This entry says so plainly instead of inventing a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and come solo. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks. PowerPyx documented the full sequence after launch.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded — Vice City streets or Ocean Beach. It is a driving-melee trick, not a bowling-alley task despite the name; the bowling alley itself belongs to Let's Go Bowling. PowerPyx confirmed the method after launch.

trophies.name: Dime On The Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each once they open in Chapter 4, so this comes naturally while doing the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, in any shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money since they cost the most. It ticks up as you buy gear for the other trophies, so check your total late in the run and top it up with a shopping spree if needed.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story-related garages do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
